risk_note: RV2 orders / settlement / union (B1-04zza; D10-676 / D10-645 / D10-649 / D10-682 / D10-689 / D10-699; BR-FUND-01, BR-FUND-02, BR-FUND-06, BR-FUND-08). Taobao refunds and punishments join the order-sync schedule: rights.window (30-minute increment, 3-hour windows, 60-day rescan with a fixed start), punish.window ([now−30 days, now), no cursor, deduplicated by order_rights_dedupe_key); every write goes through settlement rights.record (source API) after find → lock → re-read; unmatched orders are only counted. refunds.ts takes tk_commission_fee_refund as is (no alimm / agent subtraction, subsidy never enters), refund_status normalized to rights_status (14 / 15 closed without charging us → FAILED). settlement rights-command reopens only an API-source FAILED row the union later reports SUCCEEDED (audit reason union_reported_success_after_closed, alert); every other closed / regressing case stays duplicate. Union exposes rightsSources so no task is sent without an order source. Frozen refund-mapping changed per D10-645 ① / D10-682 / D10-689 (26 red_exempt confirmed).
